A specific encoding strategy within the Wavelet Coefficient Tree framework.
It encodes the positions of insignificant coefficients efficiently by representing entire hierarchies of small coefficients with a single symbol.
The concept originates from progressive image and volume compression techniques, specifically SPIHT (Set Partitioning in Hierarchical Trees) and its adaptations for volumetric subdivision meshes.
